headlines.text: On this day in 2024, a new champion was crowned for the ROH World Six Man Tag Titles as Gunns & White vs. The Embassy battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.14 ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. It was the first title opportunity of Gunns & White's career. With Bullet Club Gold's grip on the six-man titles fading, Jay White and the Gunns capitalized when The Acclaimed's Anthony Bowens stopped Prince Nana from interfering, letting White hit the Blade Runner to seize the ROH Six-Man Tag Titles from Mogul Embassy.

Turning the clock back to 2026: it was title-change night for the AEW World Trios Titles as JetSpeed & Page vs. The Opps (Hobbs, Joe & Shibata) battled it out, appearing on Collision, rated 6.56 ? ending the champion's reign at 6 defenses. For JetSpeed & Page, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Page and JetSpeed dethroned The Opps to become new AEW World Trios Champions.

Back on this day in 2024, Samoa Joe vs. Hook fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.83 ? a good, competitive contest. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2024, when it was Beretta & Cassidy's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.44.
Back on this day in 2024, Marq Quen made their long-awaited comeback after just under 14 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
That Saturday in 2026, Alexander, Clon & Fletcher touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.22.
